newsitem.title: UK: S.E.A. Multimedia restructures, plans buy.
newsitem.headline: S.E.A. Multimedia restructures, plans buy.

text.p: S.E.A. Multimedia said it had reached conditional agreement to buy an Israeli-based multimedia marketing company and added that it would restructure into three main divisions.
It said the acquisition would be paid for with new S.E.A. shares which would represent 12 percent of the enlarged issued share capital.
S.E.A. said the deal should "add significantly to the sales revenues of S.E.A. in 1997 and beyond."
S.E.A. added that it intended to seek out other such opportunities.
It said it had decided to split into three main divisions, publishing, internet tools and artificial intelligence (AI).
The AI division would be formed with an Israeli company that specialises in advanced Algorithmic AI and S.E.A. would be responsible for funding to a maximum expsoure of $1.2 million.

S.E.A. said that lower growth opportunities in CD-ROM meant that sales revenues for 1996 were expected to be $4 million compared to forecasts of $4.4 million in its May prospectus, with post-tax profits seen at $700,000, compared with $1 million forecast in May.
